description: Foundational engineering culture rules and standards enforced on AI agent-generated code.

rules.name: Zero Lazy Code & Complete Implementation
rules.description: Prohibits incomplete code generated by AI agents, including TODOs, FIXMEs, empty pass statements, or stubs without a functional body.
rules.rationale: AI agents must not deliver tasks with hidden operational gaps.
rules.remediation: Implement the logic completely or formally document the pending item in spec.md before submitting code.

rules.name: Spec Traceability Obligation
rules.description: Requires an annotation or traceability tag linking the artifact to the specification requirement (e.g., @spec RF01).
rules.rationale: Ensures strict alignment between business/architectural requirements and the implementation.
rules.remediation: Add a header comment or annotation @spec RF<number> referencing the corresponding requirement.

rules.name: Test Requirement (TDD Foundation)
rules.description: Requires every component or module to have a corresponding test file with behavioral assertions.
rules.rationale: No AI-generated code may be merged into the codebase without automated tests validating its correctness.
rules.remediation: Create the corresponding unit/integration test file covering happy and error paths.

rules.name: Zero Hardcoded Secrets and Tokens
rules.description: Detection of credentials, API keys, passwords, or sensitive tokens hardcoded in generated code.
rules.remediation: Use environment variables or secrets management vaults.

rules.name: Strict Typing & Contract Clarity
rules.description: Requires strict typing on parameters and return types of generated functions.
rules.rationale: Prevents ambiguity and runtime errors arising from type hallucinations.
rules.remediation: Explicitly declare parameter and return types for all public functions.
